# ToolScout

> ToolScout is a directory that helps you discover, compare and choose the best AI tools for writing, images, video, coding, productivity, marketing, chatbots and audio.

ToolScout is an independently researched directory of AI tools, organized by category, with comprehensive reviews covering pricing, features, pros and cons, and real user sentiment sourced from G2, Capterra and Reddit. Every tool page includes a quick-facts summary, detailed feature breakdown, full pricing tiers, and an FAQ section.

## Categories

- [Writing & Content](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/writing-content.html): Draft, edit and scale blog posts, ads and marketing copy with AI.
- [Image Generation](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/image-generation.html): Turn text prompts into original art, product shots and illustrations.
- [Video Generation](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/video-generation.html): Create video, avatars and B-roll from text or a script.
- [Coding & Development](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/coding-development.html): Pair-program, autocomplete and ship code faster with AI.
- [Productivity & Automation](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/productivity-automation.html): Automate busywork and organize your work with AI.
- [Marketing & SEO](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/marketing-seo.html): Research keywords, optimize content and track rankings with AI.
- [Chatbots & Assistants](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/chatbots-assistants.html): General-purpose AI assistants for research, writing and everyday questions.
- [Audio & Voice](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/audio-voice.html): Generate voiceovers, clone voices and edit audio with AI.
- [AEO Tools](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/aeo-tools.html): Track and improve how your brand appears in ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI answers.
- [Customer Support](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/customer-support.html): Automate customer service conversations, tickets and support workflows with AI.
- [Business & Sales](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/business-sales.html): AI tools for sales engagement, revenue intelligence, outbound, and go-to-market teams.
- [Data Analysis](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/data-analysis.html): Analyze data, build predictive models, and surface insights with AI-powered analytics platforms.
- [Design](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/design.html): Generate logos, graphics, UI mockups, and visual assets faster with AI-powered design tools.
- [No-code/Low-code](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/nocode-lowcode.html): Build apps, websites, backends, and automations without writing code, powered by AI.
- [Presentations](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/presentations.html): Generate polished slide decks, pitch decks, and infographics from a prompt or outline with AI.

## Tools

### Writing & Content
- [Jasper](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/jasper.html): AI content platform built for marketing teams — Pro from $59/mo per seat (billed yearly); Business custom-priced. No free plan.
- [Copy.ai](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/copy-ai.html): AI copywriting and GTM workflow automation — Free tier available; Chat plan from $24/mo (billed annually); Growth/Enterprise plans from $1,000/mo+
- [Grammarly](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/grammarly.html): AI writing assistant for grammar, tone and clarity — Free tier available; Pro from $12/mo (billed annually; $30/mo billed monthly)
- [Writesonic](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/writesonic.html): AI Search Visibility (GEO) platform with SEO content tools — 7-day free trial, no credit card required; plans from $79/mo billed annually
- [SummarizingTool](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/summarizingtool.html): AI summaries for text, documents, and video — plus rewriting, paraphrasing, and AI detection — Free tier available; Monthly plan from $4.99/mo
- [GoZen Content AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/gozen-content-ai.html): AI writing and image generation for SEO blogs, social posts, and ads — Free tier (2,000 AI words + 10 AI images/mo); paid plans start around $9/mo
- [Wordtune](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/wordtune.html): AI rewriting and tone assistant for confident writing — Free tier available; Unlimited plan from $6.99/mo billed annually ($9.99/mo monthly)
- [Originality.ai](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/originality-ai.html): AI content and plagiarism detector for publishers — Pro from $12.95/mo billed annually ($14.95/mo monthly), 2,000 credits/mo; Enterprise from $136.58/mo billed annually ($179/mo monthly)
- [Koala AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/koala-ai.html): SEO-optimized article generator powered by GPT-5.2 and Claude 4.5 — Plans from $9/mo (Essentials, 15,000 words); Professional $49/mo is most popular; higher-volume plans up to $2,000/mo; annual billing saves 20%
- [LanguageTool](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/languagetool.html): Multilingual grammar and style checker for 30+ languages — Free tier available; Premium from about $4.16/mo billed every 2 years (€99.90) up to €19.90/mo billed monthly; Team plans from €56.90/user/year
- [Sapling](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/sapling.html): Real-time AI language suggestions for enterprise support teams — Free browser extension; Pro $25/mo ($12/mo billed annually); Enterprise from $15/seat/mo (10-seat minimum, custom quote); metered API from a $5 minimum
- [AIPRM for ChatGPT](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/aiprm-for-chatgpt.html): Curated prompt library and toolkit for ChatGPT and Claude — Free version available; Solo plans from $20/mo up to $999/mo; Team plans from $99/mo (5 seats) up to $2,990/mo; annual billing includes 2 free months; no discounts, coupons, or refunds.
- [Bramework](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/bramework.html): AI blog writer built to turn content into customers — Flex pay-as-you-go from $0; Grow $19-29/mo; Pro $99-129/mo (monthly vs annual); Agency custom pricing
- [ContentEdge](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/contentedge.html): AI copywriting fused with real-time SEO keyword data — Free plan with basic generation; paid plans start at $29/month for full SEO tools and long-form content; free trial available
- [Contents.com](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/contents-com.html): AI content platform for SEO, social, and multilingual copy — Free plan with limited daily creations; Starter from about $29/mo; Premium around $99/mo with unlimited AI credits plus human copywriting credit; custom Enterprise pricing via sales.
- [JotBot](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/jotbot.html): Academic AI writing assistant that keeps you the author — Currently in early access/waitlist. Planned tiers: Free ($0), Plus ($12/mo), Pro ($29/mo); early-access signups get 2 free months of Pro when access opens. No credit card required to join the waitlist.
- [Keyword Caddy](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/keyword-caddy.html): AI-powered local SEO and content platform built for small businesses — SaaS Platform at $29/mo (billed annually, saving $120/yr vs monthly); 3-day free trial, no credit card required. Custom Done-For-You agency plan priced on request.
- [Lavender](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/lavender.html): Real-time AI coach that scores and rewrites your sales emails — Free plan (5 emails/month); Starter $29/mo; Individual Pro $49/mo; Teams $69/user/mo. 7-day free trial on paid plans; annual billing saves roughly 20%.
- [MovableType.ai](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/movabletype-ai.html): Turn one big idea into a full book draft in minutes — Mt Pro+ subscription $199.99/month (10 book generations/month, ~$20/book); a la carte single book $638; Agency plan (20 books/mo) custom priced; no free trial or installment plan
- [NeuralWriter](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/neuralwriter.html): Free AI paraphrasing tool that rewrites text in your own words — Completely free web tool and Chrome extension. No sign-up, no credit card, and no page limit beyond a 10,000-character-per-rewrite cap on the web tool.
- [NovelAI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/novelai.html): AI-powered storytelling and image generation for creative writers — Tablet $10/mo, Scroll $15/mo, Opus $25/mo; limited free trial with roughly 100 text generations and no image generation.
- [PaperRater](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/paperrater.html): Free grammar and plagiarism scorer, shutting down August 31, 2026 — Historically: free for up to 6 pages, $7.95 one-time for up to 15 pages, or Premium at $14.95/month for unlimited submissions. The entire service is being permanently shut down on August 31, 2026, with no migration path to a replacement product.
- [Peppertype.ai](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/peppertype-ai.html): AI short-form copywriting for ads, social, and product copy — No public self-serve pricing; quote-based enterprise plans starting around $399+/month since Pepper Content's 2026 shift toward its Atlas/AI Content Studio platform; earlier self-serve tiers are no longer offered to new signups.
- [WordHero](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/wordhero.html): One-click AI content generator with 100+ templates — Creator $29/mo billed annually ($49/mo monthly); Infinity $79/mo billed annually ($99/mo monthly) for up to 5 seats; Enterprise $199/mo; lifetime deals from $89 one-time; 14-day money-back guarantee.

### Image Generation
- [Midjourney](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/midjourney.html): AI art generator known for painterly, high-detail images — From $10/mo (Basic); no free trial; annual billing saves 20%
- [DALL-E 3](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/dall-e-3.html): OpenAI's retired image generator, formerly built into ChatGPT — Retired May 12, 2026; was included with ChatGPT Plus ($20/mo) or ~$0.04-0.08/image via API — succeeded by GPT Image 2
- [Adobe Firefly](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/adobe-firefly.html): Commercially safe AI image generation inside Adobe apps — Free tier available; paid plans from $9.99/mo (Standard)
- [Ideogram](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/ideogram.html): AI image generator with strong text-in-image rendering — Free tier available; paid plans from $20/mo (Plus)
- [ImgGen AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/imggen-ai.html): Free, watermark-free AI text-to-image generator with 120+ styles — Free (50 one-time credits, no card); Starter $9.99/mo (400 credits/mo); Pro $29.99/mo (1,400 credits/mo); custom Enterprise
- [Stable Fast 3D](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/stable-fast-3d.html): Single image to a UV-unwrapped 3D mesh in about half a second — Free for non-commercial use and commercial use up to $1M annual revenue (Stability AI Community License); Enterprise License required above that threshold; also usable via paid Stability AI Platform API credits
- [Modelia](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/modelia.html): AI fashion model generator for e-commerce product photography — Free Starter tier (20 credits/mo, watermarked); Project $12 one-time (50 credits); Basic $35/mo; Pro $85/mo; Business $300/mo — 20% off with annual billing
- [Topaz Labs](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/topaz-labs.html): AI upscaling and repair for photos, video, and AI-generated media — No free tier; single apps from $19/mo (Gigapixel, billed annually) up to $39/mo (Video AI); Studio bundle (all apps) from $45/mo annual or $69/mo monthly; Pro tier $799/yr
- [Meshy](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/meshy.html): Generate textured, rigged 3D models from text or images in minutes — Free plan with 100 credits/mo; paid plans from $20/mo (Pro) up to $100/mo (Ultra); Studio team plan from $70/mo; Enterprise custom
- [Pebblely](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/pebblely.html): Turn product photos into studio-quality scenes in seconds — Free plan available (limited monthly images, no card required); paid plans from $9/mo (Lite) up to $39/mo (Pro), with 2+ months free on annual billing
- [PhotoPacks.AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/photopacks-ai.html): Studio-quality AI headshots from a handful of selfies — One-time payment, no subscription; $24 for a headshot package (40+ images); custom bulk pricing for Teams
- [Scenario](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/scenario.html): Train custom AI models for consistent, on-brand game assets — Free tier (50 daily credits, no card required); paid plans from $15/mo (Starter) to $75/mo (Max); Enterprise custom, annual billing saves 33%
- [Asset Forge](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/asset-forge.html): Game-ready AI art assets without hiring an artist — Credit-based, no subscription; plans from $19 (4,000 credits) to $249 (65,000 credits), plus custom Enterprise pricing; 100 free credits to start
- [BGEraser](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/bgeraser.html): Free instant AI background remover, no sign-up needed — 100% free web tool with unlimited use and batch processing up to 20 images; optional desktop app: Monthly $5, Yearly $19.99, Lifetime $29.99
- [Craiyon](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/craiyon.html): The original free AI image generator, now with more style — Free tier with unlimited Lite generations; paid plans from $10/mo (Supporter) to $70/mo (Ultra), billed monthly or ~17% cheaper yearly
- [DiffusionBee](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/diffusionbee.html): Free, offline Stable Diffusion art studio built for Mac — Completely free to download and use; no paid tiers, subscriptions, or account required
- [Dzine](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/dzine.html): One AI design studio, every top image and video model — Free (100 signup credits); Beginner $8.99/mo; Creator $19.99-24.99/mo; Master $59.99/mo; Master Pro $149.99/mo; up to 22% off with annual billing
- [geni-e](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/geni-e.html): Turn one product photo into endless AI-generated variations — Free with 25 monthly credits (each download costs 2 credits); additional credit packs available for heavier use
- [Imagen AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/imagen-ai.html): AI photo editing that learns and replicates your personal style — Pay-as-you-go from $0.05/photo ($7/mo minimum); Limitless unlimited plan from $179/mo billed annually; custom Business/API plans available
- [Imagga](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/imagga.html): Image recognition APIs for tagging, moderation, and search — Free plan with 100 API requests/mo; Indie $79/mo for 70,000 requests; Pro $349/mo for 300,000 requests; custom Enterprise plan above 1M requests
- [QuickQR.art](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/quickqr-art.html): AI art that doubles as a working QR code — Free plan (watermarked, limited); Pixel ML Essentials $11/mo billed annually (1,000 credits/mo, no watermark, commercial use); API pay-as-you-go from $0.0065-$0.009/image in credit packs from $45 to $6,500.
- [Resleeve](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/resleeve.html): AI platform that builds apps, images, video and runs marketing — Basic $19/mo ($19 usage balance, ~250 images or ~25 videos); Plus $49/mo ($49 balance, ~700 images or ~70 videos); custom Enterprise plans; free trial with $25 starting credit, no credit card required
- [ThinkDiffusion](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/thinkdiffusion.html): Your own dedicated Stable Diffusion machine in the cloud — Hobby: pay-as-you-go hourly GPU rates from $0.99/hr, no subscription; TD-Pro from $19.99/mo (billed yearly) or $29.99/mo; TD-Teams $59.99/mo; custom TD-Edge training/consulting
- [VectorArt.AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/vectorart-ai.html): Turn text prompts into scalable SVG vector art instantly — Free tier for personal/educational downloads; Premium $29/mo for 1,000 images; Unlimited $99/mo for unlimited images; custom API pricing on request
- [Vectr](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/vectr.html): Free cloud vector editor now supercharged with AI image tools — Core SVG editor and logo maker are free; AI tools (image generation, vectorizer, background remover, video generator) run on paid credits/subscription via parent company Pixlr

- [Chatling](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/chatling.html): No-code AI agents for web, WhatsApp, and Instagram — Free tier (200 AI credits); Starter $25/mo, Growth $75/mo, Scale $295/mo (monthly; ~15-17% cheaper billed annually)
- [DocsBot AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/docsbot-ai.html): Turn your documentation into an AI support and sales agent — Free plan; Personal $49/mo, Standard $149/mo ($124/mo billed annually), Business $499/mo ($299/mo billed annually), custom Enterprise
- [Wonderchat](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/wonderchat.html): AI agents that answer only from your own content — Free tier (~10 resolutions/mo); Basic $124/mo, Scale $417/mo (billed annually), Enterprise from $1,499/mo
- [BoldDesk](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/bolddesk.html): AI-assisted help desk and ticketing software for fast, organized customer support — Free plan for small teams with limited agents; paid Standard and Premium tiers billed per agent per month; Enterprise tier with custom pricing for larger deployments and advanced controls. A free trial is available on paid plans.
- [Coveo](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/coveo.html): AI-powered enterprise search and generative answering for support, commerce, and workplace — Custom, quote-based enterprise pricing sold as an annual SaaS subscription; cost depends on product line (Service, Commerce, Workplace), traffic volume, and number of content sources. No public self-serve tiers.
- [Mavenoid](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/mavenoid.html): AI-powered product support automation built for hardware and electronics brands — Custom, quote-based pricing (not publicly listed); typically sold as an annual B2B contract based on ticket/interaction volume, with optional add-on services like flow building and translation management.
- [My AskAI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/my-askai.html): No-code AI chatbot trained on your own content to handle customer support — Free plan available (1 AI agent, 100 conversations/month); paid plans start around $19.99/month (Hobby), scaling to $79/month (Pro) and $299/month (Business), with custom Enterprise pricing for unlimited usage and SSO.

Exact pricing requires contacting sales for enterprise deployments.
- [Slidebean](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/slidebean.html): AI-powered pitch deck and presentation design tool built specifically for startups — Free trial available; paid plans start around $19-29/month for the design tool, with premium done-for-you design and fundraising services priced separately at higher tiers
- [AI Presentation Maker by SlideModel](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/ai-presentation-maker-by-slidemodel.html): AI slide generator backed by SlideModel's huge professional PowerPoint template library — Free to generate a limited deck; full access, downloads, and premium templates require a SlideModel subscription (monthly/annual plans)
- [SlidesPilot](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/slidespilot.html): AI PowerPoint generator that turns PDFs, Word docs, links, and videos into structured decks — Free tier with signup credits to try the generator; Pro plan around $8/month; Business plan around $20/month per user; exact tiers and page/credit limits are shown on their in-app pricing page.
- [Text2Infographic](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/text2infographic.html): AI infographic generator that turns text, blogs, or files into shareable visuals in minutes — Free to try with a few signup credits (2 free credits); primary offer is a one-time lifetime access pass for unlimited infographics (around $70, discounted from $120) rather than a recurring subscription.
